ET from rainfall

Source: R/analysis_indicators.R
wapor_calc_et_rain.Rd

ET_rain = min(AETI, P): the portion of actual evapotranspiration that cannot exceed gross precipitation in the same period. This is the green-water split with precipitation instead of USDA-SCS Peff.

Usage

wapor_calc_et_rain(
  aeti,
  precip,
  resample_method = "bilinear",
  provenance = NULL,
  compatibility_mode = c("warn", "strict")
)

Arguments

aeti

SpatRaster or numeric. Actual evapotranspiration (mm).

precip

SpatRaster or numeric. Gross precipitation (mm).

resample_method

Character. Method for resampling precip onto the aeti grid when geometries differ. Default "bilinear" (appropriate for the continuous PCP flux). Use "near" only for pre-classified rasters.

provenance

Optional named provenance records for aeti and precip.

compatibility_mode

Missing-metadata policy: "warn" or "strict". Known incompatibilities always stop the calculation.

Value

SpatRaster or numeric. ET from rainfall (mm), on the aeti grid.

Details

When precip is a SpatRaster at a different resolution or CRS than aeti (e.g. L1 PCP at ~5 km vs L3 AETI at 20 m), precip is resampled onto the aeti grid using bilinear interpolation before the comparison. The stacks must have the same layer count. When dates can be read from terra::time() or layer names, they must match in order; a mismatch stops with an error. If dates cannot be established for both stacks, a warning is issued and layers are paired by position. Pass resample_method = "near" to override.

Examples

wapor_calc_et_rain(350, 400)  # 350 mm AETI, 400 mm P -> 350 mm
#> [1] 350
